This will help you master LeaderTask.
If your task has the icon: "Sheet of paper" (it\'s on the right) - this means that the task has a note. Click the task to read it
The note is in this area
If the task has a digit-indicator in a gray circle (it\'s at the left) - that means that the task has subtasks. Click the task to see them
Open the navigator (a panel at the left), select the day in the calendar and press the round button вЂњAdd Task.вЂќ \n\n The task is created on that day.

Any project is a folder. Tasks there, work for the projectвЂ™s purposes. 

 Open the Navigator and press Add Project. 

 Any task can be related to one project. 

 Projects can be built in a matrix.
Attach tags and color tasks in the necessary color

The tag is a color label with text inside. 

 Open the task, press the Tags button, and select the necessary tags from the appropriate window. 

 To further color the task line in arbitrary colors, click the color squares under the note.

Tap the task and select "Subtasks" from the appeared menu. You will see the level of subtasks. 

 To create subtasks press the round button, вЂњadd task.вЂќ 

 It is possible to add subtasks to any subtask. Depth of enclosure is not restricted

Open the navigator and click the Today point. 

 Add tasks which need to be executed today. 

 To finish the task, click a status square (it's in a task line at the left) and select from the appeared window "Completed". 

 To hide completed tasks, press the button with an icon of three points (it's on top on the right) and select from the appeared menu "Hide completed tasks".

Come into the task and press the Assign button. Then press вЂњAdd Employee.вЂќ Enter employeeвЂ™s name and E-mail. 

 The LeaderTask assignment will be sent to him/her. 

 To see an assignment, your employee shall open the letter from LeaderTask, download the program through the link and login to the app, using the login and password specified in the letter.

Chat is built into each task. You can discuss your employees work in chat. 

 To leave a comment, open a task. Find the comment section located in the lower part of a window and send a message. 

 Pay attention to the status of your task. It's under squares of colors. All new tasks are automatically given the status "Not started". If the employee changes the status of an assignment to "Ready" (in a square the red tick appeared) - check result of the task.

Open the project. Press the button with an icon of a person (on the top right) and select the necessary employees from the opened window. 

 Selected employees will get access to the project. 

 Employees will be able to see the task list in the project, discuss them in chat, attach files and also add new tasks.

Open the necessary day of a project or the task list of an employee. 

 In the lower part of the screen swipe quickly from right to left. The mode of package operation with tasks is activated. 

 Click in turn several tasks, then press the button with a pencil icon (it's in the lower part of the screen). Select an action for the selected tasks from the appeared window.

LeaderTask has two widgets: 
 вЂњAdd to TrashвЂќ widget and вЂњAdd PhotoвЂќ widget. 

 Add widgets on a desktop. 

 Click the widget вЂњAdd to Trash.вЂќ In the appeared window enter the name of the task with a keyboard or with voice-to-text (speech will automatically be converted into text). The task will be added to the section "Inbox". 

 Click the widget вЂњAdd Photo.вЂќ The camera app will start. Make a photo and press the button with a tick icon. The task with the attached photo will be added to the section "Inbox".
Use OK Google voice command to add tasks.
Say В«OK, GoogleВ». Then say a command: В«ADD THE NOTE to take away sendingВ». \n\n The task В«Take away sendingВ» will be added to the section В«InboxВ».
Recognition of date, time, and performer in the name of the task

Open the widget вЂњAdd Task.вЂќ 

 Enter the name of the task: dictated by voice or key. 

 LeaderTask recognizes both: 
 * Date, for example: В«TodayВ», В«TomorrowВ», В«on May 15В» 
 * Time, for example: В«at 17:30В», В«at 3 pmВ», В«at noonВ» 
 * Performer. The word В«AssignВ», will appear. For example: В«To ASSIGN JamesВ» (it is necessary to use a name of the employee as it is displayed in the navigator) 

 The task will appear in the appropriate day or will be assigned to the necessary employee.

If you make a task repeat, the task will automatically appear on the to-do list of certain days. \n\n Open the task, press the Date and Reminder button and bind the task to a certain day. Then press вЂњRepeat.вЂќ In the appeared window press вЂњNot repeatвЂќ and select an interval of repetition for the task from the appeared menu. Setup an interval.

Open the navigator and open the section "Setttings" (it\'s below). \n\n You can configure more than 20 app settings. For example: notification messages, audio effects, password of an input in app, working hours, sections in the navigator, etc.

LeaderTask can automatically place tasks in a certain order. 

 Sorting is made in one of three parameters: 
 1) Date of creation 
 2) task color 
 3) Date and time the task is bound. 

 Open the necessary day, project, or to-do list of an employee. Press the button with an icon of three points (it's on the top right). Select the necessary parameters. 

 Sorting is launched manually every time it is necessary to create tasks.
